summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) class in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py returns Update(prologue, res) for non-empty requests; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py with _original_args; prepareUpdate exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_prepared_update.py covering prepare/apply, reuse, initNs, direct evaluation, initial bindings, and container shape. Nothing was run, so all changes are verified by reading only. Open conflict: the spec keeps the empty-request early return of [] but also requires evaluating an empty result not to raise. evalUpdate now reads .algebra, so an empty request still raises AttributeError. I kept the early return as written; returning Update(None, []) instead would resolve it, and I need your decision on that.
